title: Premium Percentile Ratio
description: Introduces a Premium Percentile Ratio mechanism for Filecoin network, enabling new pricing models for storage services based on percentile-based premium calculations.

storageProviders: Enables new revenue models based on premium storage services
Provides more flexible pricing mechanisms for specialized storage
clients: Allows for more granular pricing options for storage services
tokenHolders: May introduce new economic dynamics for FIL token utility
applicationDevelopers: Enables development of advanced pricing and marketplace contracts
Supports implementation of differentiated storage service markets
